hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qE '(^|/)(\.env|[^/]*\.env|config\.env|[^/]*\.key|[^/]*\.secret)$' && { echo 'Blocked: secrets file' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -d tests ] && uv run pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 || echo 'no tests yet'; }; exit 0
